findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_models, upload_media · Private data: upload_media, transcribe, get_scenario · Public sink: list_models, upload_media · Destructive: list_models, delete_character.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_models, upload_media · Private data: upload_media, transcribe, get_scenario · Public sink: list_models, upload_media · Destructive: list_models, delete_character

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
